note: A broken `devup.json` is reported instead of silently loading an empty theme. New errors: `<file> is not valid JSON: <cause>`, `<file> must hold a JSON object`, and `devup.json extends form a cycle: a -> b -> a` (previously a cycle recursed until the stack overflowed). Vite, webpack, Rsbuild and Bun log the error and clear the theme as before (Bun used to swallow it); the Next.js Turbopack setup fails with it. `theme.d.ts` is now overwritten even when the theme has no tokens, so removed tokens leave no stale declarations. Rsbuild creates the CSS directory before writing into it, so a cold start no longer fails with ENOENT
